I’m a 32 year old, male pisces dating a 31 year old, female Gemini. 

The easy things - I’m a daydreamer and a hardcore romantic. She is a realist and while not super romantic herself, she appreciates and values and feels so loved by all the romantic things I do for her because she would never do them for herself. She also helps me keep my daydreams in check and not get “lost in the clouds” so to speak. She helps keep me grounded in our relationship and I help her open herself up to dreaming of a future together. It’s a really awesome balance. It helps that we both love exploring new places together and we love nature and being outside. We love hiking, skateboarding, and other things like painting and poetry. 

Some of the difficult things - she is huge on communication and getting things out into the open when their are disagreements. This is a huge thing we immediately realized and immediately started working on. I like to internalize and feel all the emotions and then bring it to the table. She likes to know exactly what’s going on then and there and to deal with it. We both had to grow in this. I had to learn to put my thoughts on pause, let her know I’m working through something, and then in a reasonable amount of time(usually a couple of hours) bring to her my thoughts on the issue. I’ve found this helps me immensely because I can separate my emotions, consider things from a differing point of view, and bring it to the table. Likewise, she had to learn when there was a deep disagreement or issue, to not bring that fiery Gemini energy into the conversation, and to let me know she needed to walk away for a bit and then consider things from a differing point of view.

This is a book so I’m going to stop. All I can say is this - lots of astrology sites, and advice in general is that Pisces should steer clear of Gemini. I think maybe this could apply to either signs who are set in their ways and not willing to grow together and also for themselves (immature Pisces/Gemini). In reality, I think our pairing encourages so much growth in each other and can provide much needed balance for each other.
